_readme: Where shows come from. Adding a venue is one entry here — no code. The collector reads each source, keeps what is new, and puts it in the queue for review; nothing here can reach the board on its own. Each venue's robots.txt is checked on every run and a venue that asks bots to stay out is skipped. A source that has never worked only warns; one that used to work and stops fails the run. Run tools/collect_shows.py, or let the daily workflow do it.

_kinds.jsonld: A normal web page. Reads schema.org Event data — the same markup a venue already publishes so Google can show its listings. No parsing, nothing to break when they restyle the page.
_kinds.ics: A calendar feed (.ics). Google Calendar publishes one for any public calendar at https://calendar.google.com/calendar/ical/<address>/public/basic.ics

sources.note: Public community calendar. Venue comes from each event's location.
